description: This file defines a TransactionBenchmark class for testing Orleans transactions with different configurations, including setup methods for memory and Azure storage, throttling options, and running benchmarks asynchronously.

classes.name: TransactionBenchmark
classes.description: A class for benchmarking Orleans transactions with different storage and throttling configurations.

classes.name: SiloMemoryStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configures an Orleans silo to use in-memory grain storage.

classes.name: SiloAzureStorageConfigurator
classes.description: Configures an Orleans silo to use Azure Table storage for transactional state.

classes.name: SiloTransactionThrottlingConfigurator
classes.description: Configures transaction rate load shedding options for an Orleans silo.

methods.name: MemorySetup
methods.description: Sets up a test cluster with in-memory storage.

methods.name: MemoryThrottledSetup
methods.description: Sets up a test cluster with in-memory storage and throttling enabled.

methods.name: AzureSetup
methods.description: Sets up a test cluster with Azure storage.

methods.name: AzureThrottledSetup
methods.description: Sets up a test cluster with Azure storage and throttling enabled.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Runs the benchmark asynchronously, performing multiple full runs.

methods.name: FullRunAsync
methods.description: Performs a full benchmark run, collecting and reporting transaction statistics.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Runs a specific benchmark iteration with given parameters and waits for the report.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Stops all silos in the test cluster.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the test cluster resources.
